component.name: Wander
component.summary: Read ZIM archives served by cairn

description.p: Wander is a reader for ZIM archives — offline snapshots of Wikipedia and other sites — served by a cairn daemon. Point it at a cairn instance, browse what it has open, and read the entries.

Archived pages are treated as untrusted markup. JavaScript is disabled, each archive is kept on its own isolated origin with no persistent website data, and the reader cannot reach the network: entries arrive through a private URI scheme served inside the browser process, so an archived page carrying an absolute link cannot quietly fetch it.

ul.li: Browse every archive a cairn daemon has open
Title-prefix search across all archives at once
A table of contents for the entry you are reading
Find on page, with a match count
One random article, whenever you feel lucky

description.p: Pre-alpha. Reading, search, contents, history and bookmarks.
